scenes.text: Integers include positive and negative numbers. On the number line right adds and left subtracts.
Calculate 9 plus (-4). The answer is 5. On the number line, start at 9 and move -4.
The thermometer during a reading competition reads 0 degrees C and changes by -1 degrees C. What does it read afterward? Pause to choose and explain.
